patthana15.36:1.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ sāsavaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto naanāsavo na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana15.36:2.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto na anāsavo na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana15.36:3.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ sāsavaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto na anāsavo na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana15.36:4.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ sāsavaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā āsavavippayutto na sāsavo na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: dve. chagocchakaduka kusalattike chagocchakaduka
